item.text:
**Verdict:** Mostly yes. In 2024, Lula’s social-service apparatus was largely run through formal ministries, statutory conditionalities, CadÚnico/SICON, SUAS, and interministerial coordination rather than naked patronage. The main caveat is that coalition patronage and politically protected allies still existed elsewhere in the government, and some vulnerable populations still saw real delivery failures.

- **Decreto nº 12.064, de 17 de junho de 2024** | Presidência da República | 2024-06-17 | https://www.presidencia.gov.br/Ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12064.htm  
  Claim: The Bolsa Família decree assigns MDS, MEC, MS, and federative entities to manage health, education, and assistance conditionalities, explicitly tying the program to social-service access and vulnerability identification.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `6B.2`, `6B.1`

- **Portaria MDS Nº 1.041, de 23 de dezembro de 2024** | Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social | 2024-12-23 | https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/acoes-e-programas/bolsa-familia/original/privados/igd/portaria  
  Claim: The rules frame Bolsa Família management as articulated work with health, education, social assistance, CadÚnico updates, and active monitoring of vulnerable families, which is technocratic administration rather than patronage distribution.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `6B.2`

- **CGU Presente: Controladoria-Geral da União avalia condições de permanência do Programa Bolsa Família** | Controladoria-Geral da União | 2024-12-09 | https://www.gov.br/cgu/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/12/cgu-presente-controladoria-geral-da-uniao-avalia-condicoes-de-permanencia-do-programa-bolsa-familia  
  Claim: CGU says it reviewed whether condicionality monitoring was identifying and supporting vulnerable beneficiary families, which is a sign of institutional oversight and performance review.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `6B.2`

- **Presidente Lula assina decreto que atualiza regras para a implementação de políticas públicas em parcerias com as organizações da sociedade civil** | Secretaria-Geral da Presidência | 2024-03-13 | https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/marco/presidente-lula-assina-decreto-que-atualiza-regras-para-a-implementacao-de-politicas-publicas-em-parcerias-com-as-organizacoes-da-sociedade-civil  
  Claim: Lula updated the civil-society partnership framework to improve efficiency and democratize access to public-policy partnerships, which points to organized institutional delivery rather than loyalty-network governance.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `6B.1`

- **Assessorias criadas pelo presidente devem fortalecer participação social nas políticas públicas do governo federal** | Secretaria-Geral da Presidência | 2024-03-26 | https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/noticias/2024/marco/assessorias-criadas-pelo-presidente-devem-fortalecer-participacao-social-nas-politicas-publicas-do-governo-federal  
  Claim: The government says social-participation/diversity offices were installed across ministries to structure policy monitoring and dialogue with civil society, a bureaucratic channel that reduces reliance on patronage.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `6B.1`

- **Novo PAC Seleções vai investir R$ 23 bilhões em saúde, educação, esporte e cultura** | Casa Civil | 2024-03-07 | https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura  
  Claim: Lula’s government directed large, rule-based spending to UBS units, full-time schools, creches, SAMU ambulances, and other basic social infrastructure, indicating programmatic service expansion through line ministries.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `6B.2`, `6B.3`

- **Novo PAC Seleções vai investir R$ 41,7 bi em transporte, drenagem, esgotamento sanitário, abastecimento de água e infraestrutura social nas cidades** | Casa Civil | 2024-07-26 | https://www.gov.br/casacivil/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/julho/novo-pac-selecoes-vai-investir-r-41-7-bi-em-transporte-drenagem-esgotamento-sanitario-abastecimento-de-agua-e-infraestrutura-social-nas-cidades  
  Claim: The administration used a formal investment pipeline for water, sanitation, drainage, and social infrastructure, which is consistent with professionalized service delivery rather than clientelist handout politics.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `6B.2`

- **Saiba mais sobre as ações do Ministério da Saúde voltadas às pessoas com deficiência** | Ministério da Saúde | 2024-12-03 | https://www.gov.br/saude/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/dezembro/saiba-mais-sobre-as-acoes-do-ministerio-da-saude-voltadas-as-pessoas-com-deficiencia  
  Claim: The health ministry described network expansion for disability care, including rehabilitation centers and adapted transport, showing specialized service management by professionals in the sector.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `6B.3`, `6B.2`

- **Lula’s communications minister indicted in Codevasf probe; Lula did not immediately remove him** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-06-12 / 2024-06-13 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm / https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/13/lula-diz-que-tomara-decisao-sobre-juscelino-filho-e-que-indiciamento-nao-significa-que-ministro-cometeu-erro.amp.htm  
  Claim: Lula tolerated a politically connected minister after indictment, which is the clearest sign in 2024 that coalition protection and patronage still competed with clean, professional governance. This is indirect for social services, but it matters as a counterexample.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `5B.5`, `6B.1`

- **Yanomami crisis remained severe despite emergency response** | Reuters via UOL | 2024-01-26 | https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/01/26/crise-do-povo-yanomami-persiste-apos-308-mortes-em-2023-diz-relatorio.htm  
  Claim: Continued invasion, malnutrition, disease, and violence in Yanomami territory show that even when the state created formal response channels, implementation was still incomplete for a highly vulnerable population.  
  IDs: `6B.4`, also `6B.3`, `6B.2`

**Search gap**
- I found strong evidence that Lula’s social services were structured through professional, rule-based systems.
- I found much less direct independent evidence about staffing quality inside every service agency in 2024; most positive evidence is institutional design and program governance, not a full audit of personnel quality.
- The negative evidence is strongest on coalition patronage in broader cabinet politics and on delivery failure in the Yanomami case, not on a documented capture of social-service agencies by patronage networks.
